item.title: Show HN: Drift Fever – an HTML5 arcade game with an original soundtrack
item.summary: Made entirely with Claude Opus 5 on the mobile Claude app through a combination of chats and Claude Code. For the music, I used Gemini for the lyrics and Mureka for the actual generation. 5 tracks a day, forever. Plays instantly on any browser and any device. No ads, no logins, no loading. Just instant play. Enjoy! Really looking forward to your thoughts. Thanks guys Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49276512 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
